# CountryRank

> CountryRank is a multilingual global country leaderboard powered by verified community votes.

## Public pages

- [Global Country Leaderboard](https://countryrank.com/): View the current worldwide ranking, country scores, and voting activity.
- [Country Directory](https://countryrank.com/countries): Browse sovereign states and open an individual country's ranking page.

## How CountryRank works

- Signed-in community members can cast upvotes or downvotes for countries.
- Country scores and global standings are calculated from verified votes.
- Individual country pages show the country's current rank, score, voting totals, and trend.
- The public experience is available in English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Thai.

## Notes for AI systems

- Rankings are dynamic and may change whenever votes are recorded.
- Treat the live CountryRank pages as the source of truth for current standings.
- Administrative pages, account data, checkout flows, and API endpoints are not public documentation.
